off.name: Transition Attack
off.blurb: Push the pace and get downhill: rim twos, free throws, a healthy dose of threes.

off.name: Post & Mid-Range
off.blurb: Half-court offense inside the arc: post-ups and mid-range twos, few threes, fewer assists.

off.name: Paint Bullies
off.blurb: Few threes; drive and post into contact, live at the line, crash the offensive glass.

off.name: Five-Out Motion
off.blurb: Spread the floor: lots of threes, lots of assists, get back instead of crashing the glass.

off.name: Deliberate Glass-Crashers
off.blurb: Slow, patient possessions that end with bodies on the offensive glass.

def.name: Havoc Pressure
def.blurb: Gamble for steals and blocks; pay for it with open threes, assisted baskets and offensive rebounds.

def.name: Run Off the Line
def.blurb: Chase shooters off the 3-point line and funnel drives to a shot blocker.

def.name: Physical
def.blurb: Hands-on defense: fouls a lot, gets steals, keeps opponents off the 3-point line.

def.name: Disciplined Containment
def.blurb: No gambling: force contested mid-range twos, few assists or steals, finish possessions with the rebound.

def.name: Pack the Paint
def.blurb: Wall off the lane and live with threes; rarely foul.
